remarks: Thoughtfully updated single-family residence offering three bedrooms, two bathrooms, and approximately 1,449 square feet of living space on a 5,650-square-foot lot. Originally built in 1924, the home retains its classic character while incorporating recent improvements that enhance both comfort and functionality. The spacious living room is anchored by an original fireplace, creating an inviting setting that flows into a dedicated dining area. The interior offers a practical, well-proportioned layout with updated flooring, fresh paint throughout, and newly installed carpeting in all three bedrooms.
